shared_elements: standing figure with arm(s) raised in adoration/offering gesture
offering table/stand piled with goods between figures
round-topped upright stela field divided by horizontal register lines
short kilt/long garment conventions on figures
justification: Both show the same highly conventional scene: profile human figures flanking a laden offering stand, with a standing figure raising the arms in adoration toward a larger recipient figure, set in a round-topped panel with register lines and columns/bands of the same script-like signs. The chief differences are that A has a single upper scene with a standing (mummiform-like) recipient plus four long text lines below, while B has two figural registers with seated recipients and additional seated attendants, and less text.
